_comment: Copy this file to wccentral_secrets.json (same folder) and fill it in. NEVER commit wccentral_secrets.json or paste its contents into chat. The .gitignore already excludes it.
_auth_note: WordPress Application Password. Generate at https://central.wordcamp.org/wp-admin/profile.php -> 'Application Passwords' -> name it (e.g. 'Karen events dashboard') -> Add New -> copy the 24-char password it shows ONCE. Put your WordPress.org / Central login username below and the app password (spaces are fine, keep them).
app_password: xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx
